requirements: Agentio enables marketers to buy creator-led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads, automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement. Work that took months now happens in minutes
Own a revenue number. You're goaled on NDR against your book, with individual quota and individual accountability
Multi-thread and go top-down. Build relationships beyond your day-to-day contact, engage brand leadership to unstick problems, and know when and how to deploy our executives for top-to-top pressure
Manage a full portfolio. Know where the growth is in your book, keep every account healthy, and catch drift before the client tells you
Help author the playbook. Codify what works, thought-lead across the team, and shape how Agentio grows accounts as we scale
Measurement judgment that converts to commercial outcomes. You sequence what you pitch based on what the client's measurement framework will support
